title: Config report
description: POST /api/v1/reports/config (FR-2.1, P2-S02). The host's configuration facts, keyed by the fact keys of the config fact manifest (GET /api/v1/manifest/config). The body may be sent with `Content-Encoding: gzip`. Every fact the agent knows is sent with a state: `ok` with its value, or `unreadable` or `unsupported` with a reason and a null value. The server checks each value against the manifest; a fact in the manifest that the report leaves out is recorded as missing, and a key the manifest does not have is ignored and logged.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

report_id.description: UUIDv4, generated per report and reused on retry so the server can discard duplicates.

collected_at.description: When the agent collected the facts (agent clock), RFC 3339 UTC.

manifest_version.description: The `manifest_version` of the manifest the agent collected against. A version newer than the server's manifest is refused; an older one is fine, and the facts added since are recorded as missing.

facts.description: Fact key to its state, in any order. A key is a manifest fact key: `sshd.permitrootlogin`, `file:/etc/shadow`, or `service:ssh.service`.

state.description: `ok`: read, with its value. `unreadable`: the agent knows the fact but could not read it (for example, permission denied). `unsupported`: the agent cannot read this fact on this host or does not know it.

value.description: The value, of the type the manifest gives the fact, when `state` is `ok`; `null` otherwise. A file or systemd unit that does not exist is `ok` with a `null` value. The server checks the type and the manifest's limits.

mode.description: Permission bits in octal, including any special bits, for example `0640`.

owner.description: Owning user name, or the numeric id when it has no name.

group.description: Owning group name, or the numeric id when it has no name.

reason.description: Why the fact could not be read, for the operator, when `state` is `unreadable` or `unsupported`; `null` when it is `ok`.
